newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bonia plans acquisition, rights issues.
newsitem.headline: Bonia plans acquisition, rights issues.

text.p: Bonia Corp Bhd said it plans to acquire Long Bow Manufacturing Sdn Bhd for 10.5 million ringgit in cash, and that it has proposed two rights issues.

Bonia's businesses include making leather goods and property development. It said in a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Friday that Long Bow is principally involved in making leather goods.

The rights issues consist of 7.99 million new Bonia shares on a two-for-five basis, and another issue of 19.98 million ringgit in five-year, six percent irredeemable convertible unsecured loan stocks.
To accommodate the new shares under the proposed rights issues, Bonia said it seeks to increase its authorised share capital from 20 million ringgit to 50 million ringgit.
The proposed issues will raise gross proceeds of 59.94 million ringgit, part of which will be used to finance the Long Bow acquisition, Bonia said.

The acquisition will help it expand its manufacturing base and export to international markets, the statement said. "The proposed acquisition will also broaden the BCB Group's earnings base," it added.
